{{Quote|Sergeant Herral was a good soldier. He fought like a true Imperial and he died a hero.|Colonel Grang|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Esh-kha Containment|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
'''Herrall''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Part of the [[Special Operations Group Three]] sent to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] on a mission to rescue the imprisoned [[Dread Masters]], Herral perished during the mission and was given a eulogy by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Grang]].
